question: Why is the element called mahāmāyā proclaimed afterward in this teaching?
premises: Mahāmāyā is placed later in sequence.
The proclamation is made out of affection for the listener.
The teaching follows a deliberate order.
inference: Mahāmāyā is proclaimed afterward out of affection for the listener.
plain_english: Then afterward, out of affection for you, mahāmāyā is proclaimed.
